hints.title: Difference Transformation
hints.text: Rearrange the inequality to (nums1[i] - nums2[i]) + (nums1[j] - nums2[j]) > 0.

hints.title: Sort Differences
hints.text: Compute diff[i] = nums1[i] - nums2[i] for all i and sort the difference array in ascending order.

hints.title: Two Pointer Positive Sum Sweep
hints.text: If diff[left] + diff[right] > 0, then diff[right] forms valid pairs with all elements from left to right - 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs explicitly takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the differences in O(n log n) enables an optimal O(n) two-pointer pair sweep.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate algebraic rephrasing into diff[i] + diff[j] > 0 with sorting.
